description: Foxit PDF Conversion SDK for .NET. This is the entry package; the SDK binaries live in the per-platform packages listed below. Install this package to get every desktop platform, or install a single platform package directly.
releaseNotes:
# Foxit Conversion SDK v4.0.0

Release Date: 30 September 2026

## Breaking Changes

### Node.js npm package name change

English-region documentation previously used an incorrect `@fuxinsoft/...` scope. For v4.0, install and `require`/`import` must use `@foxitsoftware/foxit-pdf-conversion-sdk-node`:

```bash
# v4.0
npm i @foxitsoftware/foxit-pdf-conversion-sdk-node
# or
yarn add @foxitsoftware/foxit-pdf-conversion-sdk-node
```

**Action required:** Replace the old package name, reinstall dependencies, and verify that Node.js samples and projects load the native module.

## New Features and Enhancements

### PDF ↔ Markdown

- Add PDF-to-Markdown conversion via `foxit::conversion::pdf2md::PDF2Md::ConvertToMarkdown`, configurable via `PDF2MdSettingData` (table format, headers/footers, bold/italic retention, skipping scanned pages). Requires the `PDF2MD` module license.
- Add Markdown-to-PDF conversion via `foxit::conversion::md2pdf::Md2PDF::ConvertFromMarkdown`, configurable via `Md2PDFSettingData` (page size and margins, base font size, custom font path, style JSON, font embedding). Requires the `MD2PDF` module license.

### PDF to Office

- Improve dual-layer and scanned PDF-to-Word performance and image-only page handling
- Reduce unnecessary PDF-to-PPT output file-size growth
- Improve Lao, Myanmar, Khmer, and Thai font support in PDF-to-Word; suggested default fonts are Lao DokChampa, Myanmar Text, MoolBoran, and Thai Angsana New (DokChampa, MoolBoran, and Angsana New usually require a separate install)

## Bug Fixes

### PDF to Word

- Fix conversion failure returning error code 103 on specific files
- [Linux] Fix errors and crashes when combining OCR with the PDF2Word engine
- Fix possible hangs during PDF-to-Word conversion
- Fix failure handling bold for `MICROSS.TTF`
- Fix loss of bold on subsection titles after conversion
- Fix incorrect font substitution in PDF-to-Word and PDF-to-Excel
- [Linux C++] Fix leftover newline placeholders and errors at page bottoms
- Fix incorrect line breaks
- Fix blank pages and abnormal layout in some converted results
- Fix residual newline artifacts affecting downstream translation layout
- Fix text misclassified as shapes and TOC/bookmarks not converted to heading structure
- Fix incomplete remediation of prior Word conversion regression cases
- Fix vector regions incorrectly converted to tables
- Fix PDF/A-to-Word converting text into images
- Fix borderless tables becoming text boxes, and slow ML recognition
- Fix text mismatches between converted output and the source PDF
- Fix letter "I" misrecognized as a Roman-numeral bullet
- Improve overall PDF-to-Word quality on specific samples

### PDF to Excel

- Fix crashes on specific files with `e_WorkbookSettingsEachPage` or `e_WorkbookSettingsEachTable`
- Improve poor PDF-to-Excel quality caused by the underlying engine
- Fix cell fill colors exported as images instead of fill

### Word to PDF

- Improve overall Office-to-PDF quality
- Fix font weight and horizontal-line position mismatches against the source
- Fix missing nested tables
- Fix incorrect table numbering
- Fix missing glyphs, extra spaces, and header page-count errors
- Fix text color changes, missing content, and incorrect table structure
- Fix rewritten heading numbers and inconsistent page counts
- Fix layout errors that inflated page counts

### Excel to PDF

- Fix radio buttons not displayed
- Fix image stacking/offset covering document content
- Fix punctuation mojibake

### PowerPoint to PDF

- Improve PPTX-to-PDF output quality
